text: 9月10日，商务部部长王文涛与塞舌尔财政、经济规划、贸易和投资部部长拉波特签署《中华人民共和国政府与塞舌尔共和国政府关于共同发展经济伙伴关系协定早期收获的安排》，国际贸易谈判代表兼副部长李成钢与塞方会见，并交换早期收获安排文本。根据早期收获安排，中方将对塞方实施100%税目产品零关税，塞方也将进一步对中方开放市场。（商务部）
text_en: On September 10, Commerce Minister Wang Wentao and Seychelles Minister of Finance, Economic Planning, Trade and Investment Laporte signed the "Arrangement on Early Harvest of the Agreement on Jointly Developing an Economic Partnership between the Government of the People's Republic of China and the Government of the Republic of Seychelles." International Trade Negotiation Representative and Vice Minister Li Chenggang met with the Seychelles side and exchanged the text of the early harvest arrangement. Under the early harvest arrangement, China will apply zero tariffs on 100% of tariff lines to Seychelles, and Seychelles will further open its market to China. (Ministry of Commerce)
